name: How is plumbing handled when adding a sink to a new kitchen island?

mainEntity.name: How is plumbing handled when adding a sink to a new kitchen island?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plumbing lines can be run to a kitchen island, but the installation method depends directly on your home's foundation type. In homes built on a concrete slab, routing new supply and drain pipes requires cutting and trenching the slab, laying pipe, and patching concrete. In homes over a crawl space, routing utilities underneath is generally faster and less invasive. Proper venting is a crucial detail: because an island lacks an adjoining wall for traditional vertical vent stacks, code-compliant air admittance valves or loop vents must be integrated inside the island cabinetry to ensure proper wastewater drainage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plumbing is run through the subfloor or by trenching a concrete slab, using specialized island loop vents or air admittance valves for drainage.
